freeze_policy: Definitions, budgets, ordering, proxies, F subtypes, and recommendation rules may not change after the first replay.

repair_set.eligibility: target currently wrong AND exact repository team vote currently wrong
priority_order: R2: G=1 fragmented/orphan residual not already R1
R4: remaining current branch responsibility residuals
repair_set.minimal_redundancy: Only the selected target's uniquely routed branch portfolio is considered; vote-correct residuals are excluded.

preservation_set.candidate_pool: examples where target is currently correct
preservation_set.P1: Mark target invalid while peers remain fixed; repository plurality changes correct to incorrect.
preservation_set.P2: Parent vote is correct and target removal decreases exact plurality margin without causing the P1 flip.
preservation_set.P3: Remaining target-correct examples correct in every accepted state observed up to the parent state; rank by longer observed state support then question_hash.
preservation_set.budget_allocation: Fill globally in tier order up to six; question_hash ascending within P1/P2 and support-length descending then question_hash within P3.
preservation_set.counterfactual_semantics: target validity=false and target answer unchanged; all four peers fixed; exact repository plurality
preservation_set.use: generation guidance diagnostic only, never a new acceptance guard

variants.preservation_context: historical v15 context only; no newly constructed preservation set

variants.prompt_context_prototype:
Repair responsibilities:
- [RESIDUAL_A]
- [RESIDUAL_B]
Provide only the minimum additional support needed for the ensemble; stop propagating an item once the team vote is correct.

Repair responsibilities:
- Focus on [RESIDUAL_A] and [RESIDUAL_B], which remain unresolved team responsibilities.
- Provide the minimum additional support needed for consensus.
Preservation responsibilities:
- Preserve [CAPABILITY_A] and [CAPABILITY_B].
- Do not gain local accuracy by sacrificing existing stable or vote-critical competence.

Repair responsibilities:
- [RESIDUAL_A]: G=[G], r=[R], class=[BOUNDARY_CLASS], role=[TARGET_ROLE].
Preservation responsibilities:
- [CAPABILITY_A]: tier=[PRESERVATION_TIER].
Improve one-repair-away responsibilities while preserving vote-critical and stable capabilities; avoid local gains that damage the team.

fixed_pool_proxy_rules.repair_gain: At least one repair-set item has target_correct_delta>0 OR repair_distance_delta<0 OR vote_delta>0.
fixed_pool_proxy_rules.preservation_violation: A preservation-set item changes target correctness from true to false.
fixed_pool_proxy_rules.fixed_pool_oracle: At least one historical common-safe candidate has repair_gain; C2/C3 additionally require zero P1/P2 loss.

ordered_rules: F_TARGET_DEGRADATION: no C1 repair gain and target_gain<0
F_LOCAL_NO_PROGRESS: no C1 repair gain, target_gain=0, vote_net_gain<=0

recommendation_rules.C1: Recommend only if context attrition is dominant and preservation signals provide little useful discrimination.
recommendation_rules.C2: Recommend if C1 improves explicit exposure, preservation strongly overlaps historical collateral loss, and complexity remains reasonable.
recommendation_rules.C3: Recommend only if coalition metadata provides meaningful additional design information over C2 without excessive complexity.
recommendation_rules.NONE: Recommend if fixed-trajectory evidence does not support repair/preservation construction.
